_note: All banter is BACKGROUND and NON-BLOCKING. Lines show in #explore-notif via showMsg(), player never stops moving. Post-boss entries are handled separately by _openGenericDialogue() in story.js. requires_party: [] means fires regardless of party. requires_party: ['aya'] means Aya must be in active party.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: The flowers are gone. But the soil still knows where they were.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: My grandmother walked this road. She described it differently.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: I think she was being kind.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: You know what bothers me? The silence. Places like this should be loud with the living.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: It isn't.

lines.speaker: Ria
lines.text: The crystals remember sound. If you listen carefully, you can almost hear them.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: It is cold here, but not the cold I know. This cold has grief in it.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: There is something buried deep in this place. Something that was once a person.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: I can smell the years on it.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: Finally. Somewhere that matches my disposition.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: This heat is different from fire. It has been here a very long time.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: Something about this place feels like home. Is that strange?

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: The water remembers everything that has ever moved through it.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Here, the water is very tired.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: The ghosts here are different. They don't want to talk.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: They just want to be seen.

lines.speaker: Valka
lines.text: I have judged souls in places darker than this.

lines.speaker: Valka
lines.text: None of them were at peace either.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: I have walked through the halls of gods.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: This place does not feel like gods were here. It feels like gods were defeated here.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Six hundred years of this. I can taste it.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: We end it here.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: The fire is almost out. I don't mind.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: I used to need an audience. I think I outgrew it.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: You slept. Good.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: I wrote a small poem last night. About the ash.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: It was honestly pretty good. I'm not going to share it.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.text: I dreamed about my kingdom again.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.text: It was good. I'm glad I remembered it before waking.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: The fire burns differently here than at home.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: I am not sure what that means. I notice it anyway.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: He had a name before all of this.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: I hope someone still knows it.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: He did not want to fight. I could feel it in each swing.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: That does not make it easier. It makes it worse.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: His oath was to protect the Vale. He never stopped, even like this.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: I understand that.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: The Azure records say he was a fair king. Once.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: I believe that. Looking at him. I believe it.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: A sovereign who could not protect his people.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: There is no greater failure. I know that better than most.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: He never stopped reaching for it. Even at the very end.

lines.speaker: Ria
lines.text: He wanted to know everything. There is nothing wrong with that.

lines.speaker: Ria
lines.text: The Void just found him before wisdom did.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: He was a scholar once. You could still see it.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: He never stopped being curious. Even at the end, he was asking questions.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Two thousand years. The dark always looks the same.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: And yet I am still surprised by it.

lines.speaker: Valka
lines.text: The stars here are arranged wrong.

lines.speaker: Valka
lines.text: I have been trying to name them anyway.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: This is the quietest I have ever heard the world.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: The Void is talkative today.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: I'm not answering it.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: Stay close. The air is wrong here — I can feel it in the armor.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Rest soon. The Void grows louder when we are tired.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.text: The constellations in my world had different names.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.text: I've been looking for ones I recognize. Not yet.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: The wind just changed direction. Something is moving, far away.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: I led two hundred years of council meetings.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: Standing still like this is somehow harder.

lines.speaker: Ria
lines.text: My eidolons are restless. They sense something nearby.

lines.speaker: Ria
lines.text: Not an enemy. Something older.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: Formation set. The doctrine holds.

lines.speaker: Valka
lines.text: This arrangement will do.
